denominator: All frozen expected foreground rows in every required repetition; failed/omitted rows never removed
scope_admission: Only FIDELITY_PASS; any unexplained fraction >0 fails scientific eligibility

statuses.FIDELITY_FAIL: Any attempted row fails bound, raises error or yields nonfinite attribution/output
statuses.FIDELITY_MIXED: Attempted rows pass but expected rows missing; diagnostic only, scope inadmissible
statuses.FIDELITY_PASS: Every expected row attempted and passes finite residual bounds

threshold_origin: 56.3A strict completion rule; no numerical tolerance changes
